propositions: docs/ticket-model.md hand-maintains an outdated ticket taxonomy that lists five statuses instead of the seven canonical statuses (idea, open, in_progress, blocked, closed, archived, deleted) and fewer ticket types than the canonical seven (bug, epic, story, task, session_log, code_review, identity) defined in src/rebar/types.py

A deterministic generator script must extract TicketType and TicketStatus literals from src/rebar/types.py:21-23 and regenerate a marked taxonomy section in docs/ticket-model.md while preserving all hand-maintained relationship prose outside that section

The generator must support both write mode (regenerate the marked block) and check mode (exit non-zero if documentation is stale relative to the canonical source or if vocabulary has been added without regeneration)
Generation must be deterministic and idempotent; running twice must produce no diff on the second run
Unit tests must verify that the generated block includes all seven current types and statuses, that non-taxonomy prose is preserved, and that stale or missing vocabularies are detected by check mode
